notes.title: Version 1.2
notes.notes: V1.2. I have made the game easier due to a few complaints about difficulty levels and have added some extra hints etc to find combos which are hidden in the game. Apologies for making the game so difficult, hopefully this will make the experience better

notes.title: Patch 1.1
notes.notes: Fixed issues with primary controller input. I was getting feedback that if there was a primary controller that was not a joypad then inputs would not be recognized by a joypad that was not the primary controller. This should be fixed now and the framerate has been capped at 150 FPS as there was a complaint that the framerate was getting up to 400-500FPS at times for some people which was causing high CPU loading.

notes.title: Get Ready to Play Kung Fu Jesus!
notes.notes:
There are burning questions we’re sure you’ve been asking yourselves: Who really is [i]Kung Fu Jesus[/i]? Is any of this [b]real[/b] or merely psychosis?

All your questions will be answered – and more – very soon! We’re delighted to announce that Kung Fu Jesus will be available on [b]Thursday, May 27.[/b]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/jZaRdbJ.gif[/img]

We can’t wait for you to check it out! Until then, you can reach out to us in the Steam community hub or follow on [url=https://www.facebook.com/kungfujesusgame/]Facebook[/url], [url=https://twitter.com/kungfujesusgame]Twitter[/url], and [url=https://www.instagram.com/kung.fu.jesus/]Instagram [/url]for updates :)

notes.title: Your third eye opens today. Are you ready?
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35759495/ae8690adcbbf4266c1021642084b053e4d08808b.png[/img]
The mysteries of the universe have unravelled to reveal that Kung Fu Jesus will be releasing on Steam in 2020.

[b]WISHLIST NOW![/b]

The name Kung Fu Jesus has previously existed as a vessel for my previous musical releases. Now I’m setting out to tell the story of my fictional namesake, drawing inspiration from Japanese and Norse culture, as well as some of the most free-thinking minds of the 20th and 21st century, and my own experiences exploring the boundaries of consciousness.

Prepare to enter a madcap world of organised crime, alternate dimensions, and intense martial arts, in a genre-busting action-adventure like no other.

Check out the announcement trailer and prepare to wake up to the hidden world around you.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=E7ATcvtyHKE
